Class ParquetSchema

The schema of a Parquet file as a tree, with the definition and repetition levels of every node and the leaf Columns in the order their chunks are stored.

Remarks

A logical type that does not suit its column (or that this library does not know) is ignored, as the spec requires, leaving the physical type to describe the data.

The element list is not a well-formed depth-first tree.
